description: Send a customer reply in an open Direct conversation and notify the business. Sign in as the original requester with direct:tasks, or supply the private thread_token. A delivered reply uses the same monthly allowance, then prepaid credits, as take_message. Reuse message_id when retrying; closed conversations refuse replies.

message_id.description: Your id for this reply; reuse it unchanged when retrying.

text.description: The customer’s reply to the business.

thread_token.description: The private thread_token; required unless signed in as the requester who started the thread.

name: reply_to_business
title: Reply in a business conversation
